selectionEntries.comment:
A single 80-point parent Character with one mutually exclusive polymorphic *body*: default Warp Armour (including optional Jump Pack/Bike/Daemonic Steed), Terminator Armour, or Heavy Weapon. Keep 👑 Warlord designation at parent level and the single shared Additional Options/Mark group *outside* all bodies so it survives body changes. Do not restore redundant body-specific Mark copies. Daemon Weapon checks on this parent use the shared selected Mark, independent of which body supplied the weapon. Two independent Lightning Claws trigger model-local pistol removal; for Warp Armour paired claws with Bike or Daemonic Steed, show an error instead of hiding a choice (Jump Pack is allowed). The single 'Chaos Lord' hidden keyword counts this unit toward the shared one-per-army restriction, including future specialized Lord identities. Do not recreate a separate shared-limit modifier per body.
IRON WARRIORS: In-roster Allegiance changes this unit's [Legion] metadata and visible Keywords profile. Every 'Mark of Chaos' purchase has a local corrective error when Iron Warriors is selected unless the owning unit has the Psyker (X) eligibility category. Scope that exception to the owning unit; a Psyker elsewhere in the roster must NOT legalize it. Category/tag and profile text must update together on future changes. Only apply Psyker tag to real Psyker (X) configurations, never generically to a unit that might become Psyker.
IRON WARRIORS CHARACTER WARGEAR: The three independent upgrades live under 🧰 Options immediately after 👑 Warlord and outside all polymorphic bodies. Each is +10/+5/+10 Points respectively, Iron Warriors-only, with selected-safe conditional visibility and corrective validation; see the group comment for the reason to keep them on the parent unit.
V1.4.30 MARK VALIDATION CORRECTION: Iron Warriors Mark restrictions belong to the owning top-level unit, not to each unselected radio option. Each unit-level corrective modifier explicitly requires its corresponding Mark selection (scope=self; one per Mark choice), Iron Warriors allegiance, and absence of unit-local Psyker eligibility. The empty (None) radio must produce no errors; select a Mark under Iron Warriors for one corrective error. Preserve every existing Mark choice, ID, price and radio structure. Do not migrate validation back to unselected option nodes. Live NR testing remains necessary, particularly Psyker exception semantics.
V1.4.31 SHRAPNEL AUDIT: 5 added Iron Warriors-only shrapnel alternatives in existing weapon radios. The parent-unit errors explicitly check each selected shrapnel option; hide-on-other-allegiance is selected-safe. Existing weapon radio defaults and non-Shrapnel choices remain unchanged. Review future weapon additions for shrapnel companions and claw/pistol exceptions.

IRON WARRIORS RELIC IMPLEMENTATION V1.4.32: Inside 🧰 Options, place ⚙️ Iron Warriors Relics (one optional 0/1 radio containing all five supplement Relics) BEFORE ⚙️ Iron Warriors Wargear (renamed from ⚙️ Iron Warriors). Purchase and pay for the Relic once in the radio, independent of its equipped weapon display. Fleshmetal Exoskeleton +35, Cranium Malevolus +15, Warpbreacher +10 have no additional weapon action, are pure wargear purchases, and must NOT print their special rules as profiles; Spite Spitter +5 replaces Boltgun; The Axe of the Forgemaster +5 replaces Power Axe. For weapon relics, add ⚙️ replacement directly after each exact source weapon option with *the original weapon cost* (e.g. Power Axe +10 -> ⚙️ The Axe of the Forgemaster +10 in radio PLUS +5 on Relic purchase; Boltgun 0 -> ⚙️ Spite Spitter 0 PLUS +5 purchase). New weapon choices hide until their corresponding unit Relic is purchased, except if the choice is already selected, and each owning unit validates missing purchase, purchase-but-not-equipped, and >1 equipped copy. Unit-root (not unselected-choice) validations prevent stale Mark-of-Chaos-style false errors. All Relic purchases are Iron Warriors-only, one per Character via 0/1 group. Every named Relic is at most once across the army, using explicit roster checks covering every Character that can purchase the same named Relic; EXTEND THESE CROSS-UNIT CHECKS whenever another eligible Character is created. In future, add Relic options for all qualified non-Unique Characters, never Unique, with selected-safe visibility and three-sentence corrective errors. Core generic Relics, if implemented later, must share the no-more-than-one-Relic-on-a-Character condition. If a Character has no suitable Boltgun/Power Axe weapon slot, choosing a weapon Relic correctly produces the unequipped Relic error rather than inventing a weapon slot.
V1.4.44 CHAOS MARKS: radio label "Chaos Marks"; purchasing a Mark grants the exact god/Undivided Keyword to both the unit semantic categories and visible Allegiance-dependent Keywords profile. Psyker (X) + Mark of Khorne is prohibited for every Allegiance, by a top-level selected-gated corrective error. The previously implemented separate Iron Warriors Mark restriction is untouched. No attachment validation is implied by these keywords.

ATTACHMENTS (V1.4.45): Ported proven Reforged roster-scoped per-unit-instance association as Attaches To (min0/max1), targeting hidden May Attach To: The Long War Character (Infantry) category. Only Infantry hosts with at least two models have this category. 0 associations is allowed: Long War Character attachment is optional absent an explicit compulsory attachment rule. Host root prevents a second attaching Character. V1.4.46: attachment compatibility is checked using effective Keywords, not Marks. Semantic Keywords from native categories or Mark-derived category modifiers grant an equivalent Character-only keyword proxy. Only host-local incoming associations and these Character-specific proxies are used for two-way comparison. Shared one-Chaos-Lord-family-per-army cap remains a dependency. If this Character ever gains a different Unit Type (e.g. mounted) add tested conditional type gating rather than letting a mismatched type attach. Do not turn this into numeric unit-class chooser.
V1.4.46 KEYWORDS: conditional Character-only category aliases are based on local instanceOf(semantic Keyword), never a Mark option ID. If a new independent Character type becomes legal simultaneously, this roster-proxy method MUST be replaced with per-association specific-character lookup.

THE LONG WAR / CHAOS SPACE MARINES — CURRENT-STATE HANDOFF (updated 2026-11-01)

IRON WARRIORS — FIRST-STOP CHECKLIST FOR EVERY NEW UNIT (V1.4.34; standalone reference: THE_LONG_WAR_IRON_WARRIORS_NEW_UNIT_CHECKLIST.md). READ BEFORE CODING A UNIT. The checklist is reproduced here so this JSON remains self-documenting if the .md is not alongside it.
ALL UNITS: Check Iron Warriors eligibility against source PDF; maintain correct [Legion] semantic category and visible Keywords; Marks prohibited without unit-local Psyker (X), with validation checking ACTUAL selection on the owning unit; audit Bolt Pistol -> ⚙️ Shrapnel Bolt Pistol, Boltgun -> ⚙️ Shrapnel Boltgun, Combi-Bolter/Linked Boltgun -> ⚙️ Linked Shrapnel Boltgun, Heavy Bolter -> ⚙️ Shrapnel Cannon, Linked Heavy Bolter -> ⚙️ Linked Shrapnel Cannon (+2 per replaced weapon). Search ALL model, Champion, expanded and atomic loadouts; preserve originals and duplicate suitable shrapnel combinations with multiplied prices. Extend paired-Lightning-Claw/pistol checks. Put ⚙️ sections FIRST; direct optional 0/1 upgrades are checkboxes; use selected-safe hide and owning-unit, selected-gated three-sentence corrective errors. Preserve existing IDs, document new nontrivial implementation decisions, verify in New Recruit.
CHARACTER ONLY (if Character special rule, Iron Warriors, and non-Unique for Relics): top order ⚙️ Iron Warriors Relics -> ⚙️ Iron Warriors Wargear -> 👑 Warlord (if Warlord eligible) -> normal bodies. Wargear checkboxes: Enhanced Bionics +10, Techno-Venomous Mechatendrils +5, Nest of Mechaserpents +10. Relic 0/1 radio: Fleshmetal Exoskeleton +35; Cranium Malevolus +15; Warpbreacher +10; Spite Spitter +5; The Axe of the Forgemaster +5. Boltgun -> ⚙️ Spite Spitter and Power Axe -> ⚙️ The Axe of the Forgemaster only where those radios exist; Relic surcharge is paid on purchase radio once, weapon option keeps original slot price. Enforce purchased-but-unequipped, equipped-without-purchase, duplicate-equipped, one Relic per Character and ONE OF EACH NAMED RELIC across the ENTIRE army: extend existing global checks whenever another Character is added. Warlord-eligible units need conditional separate Core and ⚙️ Iron Warriors trait radios (Master of Blasphemous Machines; Master of Fortifications; Master of Ruinous Ordnance), selected-safe dynamic minimums, and one-Warlord cap. Shared Chaos Lord one-per-army applies only to actual Chaos Lord-family variants, NOT all Characters or squad Champions.
MODEL-/DATASHEET-SPECIFIC: Chaos Lord or Chaos Champion with eligible Power Maul may exchange for ⚙️ Graviton Mace at original Power Maul price +2; Chosen/Chosen Champion with eligible Close Combat Weapon may take ⚙️ Siege Breaker Mace +20; Legionnaire/Aspiring Champion in Legionnaire Squad may take Boarding Shields for +3 per model, implemented as +15 (5 models) or +30 (10 models) squad checkbox. Check exact datasheet legality; never apply Character-wide equipment simply because a model is called Champion. The Long War PDFs remain authority; no battlefield Special Rules text in builder. Rites and future exclusive units remain to be implemented incrementally.
END QUICK CHECKLIST. Detailed architecture/historical notes follow.

SCOPE: One independent faction catalogue for the separate Long War Game System. Reforged is a UX/technical reference, not this game's rules authority. Do not modify Reforged assets. Current actual units: Chaos Lord, Warsmith and Daemonsmith (Iron Warriors), Legionaries (5/10), Chosen in Power Armour (5/10), Chosen in Terminator Armour (5/10). All remaining TEST units are deliberately artificial, cost 100 Points each and exercise Battlefield Role validation; replace them only as real datasheets are drafted. The Rite selector still contains *inert test options*. Iron Warriors has Allegiance identity, Mark/Psyker restrictions, Warsmith and Daemonsmith, Boarding Shields, Character Wargear, Relics, Warlord Traits and shrapnel weapons implemented. Iron Warriors Rites remain unimplemented.
BUILDER MODEL: 'None', 'Black Legion', and 'Iron Warriors' are catalogue-level Force Entries so New Recruit displays the choice at Create List. An optional in-roster Allegiance selector starts at native (None) and can be changed afterward; the in-roster chosen Black Legion/Iron Warriors entry (not merely the original force) switches [Legion] to that Allegiance in hidden categories and the visible emoji Keywords profile. Rite is also optional with native (None). Crucial: 'None' is not an invented named Allegiance. Preserve validation across all three Force variants. The Long War core rules treat singular/plural keyword forms as equivalent. For internal semantic categories, select one stable canonical identity per keyword when adding new features; do not rewrite existing stable IDs merely to normalize spelling (e.g. 'Veterans' and 'Chaos Lord' are natural canonical choices). The unit keyword IDs are not the same thing as the IDs of selectable Marks; don't assume all Marks share a selection ID. Mark options now share a hidden 'Mark of Chaos' semantic category, while the Game System owns 'Psyker' eligibility. Only grant Psyker to actual Psyker (X) configurations; check per unit, not roster-wide.
PRESENTATION: Primary categories are the actual slot headings; hidden secondary categories carry Types and PDF keyword identities, with emoji-bearing '🏷️ Keywords' profiles for visibility. The formatted unit prefix is ◆ plus U+2007 FIGURE SPACE. Grouped models are permitted for common configurations, but independently replaceable weapons need independent slots. Use '🧰 Options' for loadouts and 'Additional Options' for shared wargear/Marks; for the polymorphic Chaos Lord the latter is outside the body selector so choices persist across bodies. Keep individual Chosen model wrappers to prevent ambiguous export consolidation.
VALIDATION: Per-force category links implement permissive-corrective role maxima, Dedicated Transport entitlement (one per selected Troops or Elite choice) and Lord of War eligibility based on the *actual roster cost* >= 2000, not the configured Cost Limit. Configuration-category checks protect missing Allegiance, Rite, Mandatory HQ, Mandatory Troops and Mandatory Warlord entries; don't add errors just because their progress counters are incomplete. The single 'Chaos Lord' semantic category enforces a shared one-per-army cap for Chaos Lord, Warsmith, Daemonsmith and future Sorcerer/Master of Possessions/Discordant variants. One selected Warlord marker per army. No hard maximum blockers or deletion of selected options on invalidation. Corrective messages follow 'problem; rule; correction'.
LOADOUT POLICY: Catalogue, not calculator. Use common 5-or-10 model packages (Nobz-style) where intended; PDFs remain authoritative for omitted legal intermediate sizes. Lightning Claws are atomic equipment options. Paired claws are inferred by selecting both model-local slots; pistol radio becomes optional, and any retained pistol or forbidden Bike/Steed combination raises a corrective error. Deliberate simplified paired prices may differ from PDF (Warp Armour Chaos Lord +20 instead of PDF paired +15; Terminator Chosen two independent claws +15 instead of PDF paired +20). Do not 'fix' this without explicit design approval. No battlefield Special Rules text is included.
CHECKPOINT/TESTING: Early V3.3 scaffold was confirmed working in New Recruit. Current later faction changes have undergone structural/static checks; dynamic pistol (1/1->0/1), selected-safe error timing, Keywords profile switching, armour price scaling, and export grouping still merit live checks. Iron Warriors Allegiance, Mark/Psyker restriction, Boarding Shields, Character wargear/relics/traits, and shrapnel alternatives are implemented on existing eligible units; Iron Warriors Rites remain unimplemented. Live tests still needed for the per-unit Psyker exception and new Allegiance initial selection/switching. This comment states current behavior and known caveats, not a revision-by-revision changelog.
WARSMITH (CURRENT STATE): Separate 115-point Iron Warriors-only Chaos Lord-keyword unit. The two bodies are Warp Armour and user-permitted (non-PDF) Terminator Armour; both replace the original melee weapon with Siege Breaker Mace & Servo Arm or Chainfist & Servo Arm. Heavy Weapon, Jump Pack, ranged-slot Lightning Claw, Daemon Weapon and Marks are absent. Keep the Iron Warriors-only conditional error and the shared Chaos Lord count. See unit-local comments for the equipment rationale.
DAEMONSMITH (CURRENT STATE): Iron Warriors-only Chaos Lord-keyword unit with its own IDs, Warlord checkbox, shared accessories, Warp and deliberate non-PDF Terminator bodies. Both bodies have mandatory Graviton Mace & Servo Arm. Uses the same semantic one-Chaos-Lord-per-army cap; see unit-local comment for the rules-deviation boundary.
IRON WARRIORS BOARDING SHIELDS (CURRENT): Legionaries offer a selected-safe ⚙️ Iron Warriors checkbox before 🧰 Options. +15 for the 5-model squad, +30 when the existing additional-five package is selected; ineligible Allegiance shows a three-sentence corrective error rather than deleting the choice. No per-model shield permutations.
IRON WARRIORS CHARACTER WARGEAR (CURRENT): The Chaos Lord, Warsmith, and Daemonsmith (the currently implemented units sharing the Chaos Lord keyword) each have an ⚙️ Iron Warriors Wargear heading above 👑 Warlord and before polymorphic bodies in 🧰 Options. Each has independent (0/1) Enhanced Bionics +10, Techno-Venomous Mechatendrils +5, and Nest of Mechaserpents +10 upgrades. Group/selection/constraint IDs are unique for each unit; shared Allegiance check references the same Iron Warriors selection. Hide headings outside Iron Warriors only if unselected; retain already chosen upgrades and show local corrective errors after an Allegiance change. Keep on parent rather than duplicating inside bodies. The supplement grants these upgrades to any Iron Warriors Character, so future eligible Characters should be audited individually as they are built.
IRON WARRIORS GRAVITON MACE REPLACEMENTS (CURRENT): The Iron Warriors supplement permits a Chaos Lord or Chaos Champion to exchange an equipped Power Maul for a Graviton Mace at +2 Points. For every existing Power Maul radio option in Chaos Lord, Warsmith and Daemonsmith bodies, the corresponding radio now contains ⚙️ Graviton Mace directly after Power Maul, priced as that particular Power Maul option plus 2 (12 or 17 Points). Do not copy a single flat price: the Power Maul in Terminator melee is cheaper than in the ranged slot. Options are selected-safe: hidden while unselected without Iron Warriors, but left visible with a three-sentence corrective error if the selected Allegiance changes. Existing Power Mauls remain intact. The Warsmith and Daemonsmith already have distinct required Siegebreaker/Graviton Mace & Servo Arm equipment; those default identity weapons are NOT replaced by these new optional Power Maul exchanges. Apply the same pattern to future eligible Chaos Champions only after reviewing their actual Power Maul radios. All eight new entries have unique IDs. Live New Recruit validation is still unverified.
IRON WARRIORS CHOSEN SIEGE BREAKER MACE (CURRENT): 10 separate ⚙️ Siege Breaker Mace (+20) replacement options now exist on Chosen in Power Armour Champion and models 2-10, inserted into their existing Close Combat Weapon radios. No options added to Terminator Chosen. Same selected-safe Iron Warriors gate and corrective errors as the existing Graviton Mace pattern. Do not share weapon selection IDs across model instances, and do not consolidate per-model weapon exports.
V1.4.30 CORRECTION: Live New Recruit screenshot showed all unselected Mark of Chaos radio choices incorrectly flagged under Iron Warriors, even with (None) selected, because 18 child-level error modifiers omitted a selected-Mark requirement. Relocated one selected-safe condition set per exact Mark to its owning top-level unit; gate now requires roster Iron Warriors, owning unit's selected Mark, and owning unit lacking Psyker eligibility. V1.4.31 IRON WARRIORS SHRAPNEL WEAPONS (PERMANENT FUTURE-UNIT RULE): For EVERY newly implemented unit, audit all eligible Bolt Pistol, Boltgun, Combi-Bolter/Linked Boltgun, Heavy Bolter and Linked Heavy Bolter selectable weapons, including Champion/extra-model bodies, ranged slots, pistol slots and atomic loadouts. Insert a separate ⚙️ allegiance-specific choice immediately after the standard option: Bolt Pistol -> ⚙️ Shrapnel Bolt Pistol, Boltgun -> ⚙️ Shrapnel Boltgun, Combi-Bolter/Linked Boltgun -> ⚙️ Linked Shrapnel Boltgun, Heavy Bolter -> ⚙️ Shrapnel Cannon, Linked Heavy Bolter -> ⚙️ Linked Shrapnel Cannon. The new price is the original replacement price +2 per weapon swapped. Never edit the base option or flatten existing multi-model atomic choices: duplicate those choices and create the distinct useful permutations. Example: 4x Chainsword & Bolt Pistol remains free, while ⚙️ 4x Chainsword & Shrapnel Bolt Pistol costs +8; 3x Boltgun & Bolt Pistol gets pistol-only +6, boltgun-only +6 and both +12. The grouping means all grouped models swap a given weapon type together, no individual model mixing within that grouped radio. Preserve model-local independent slots, default IDs and paired Lightning Claw pistol prohibitions (both normal and shrapnel pistols). IW-only hide when unselected and non-IW; a selected option remains visible on an Allegiance switch and receives an owning-UNIT selected-gated corrective error (do NOT put unconditional errors on unselected radio children, see V1.4.30 bug). No existing Linked Boltgun or Linked Heavy Bolter radio choices existed in V1.4.30; future units still must implement them if relevant. Shrapnel names intentionally retain ⚙️ for visual allegiance identity. This catalogue is not a rules engine; static checks passed; live New Recruit validation still needed.

V1.4.32 IRON WARRIORS RELICS HANDOFF: All five from supplied supplement text: Fleshmetal Exoskeleton (+35), Cranium Malevolus (+15), Warpbreacher (+10), Spite Spitter (+5, Boltgun exchange), The Axe of the Forgemaster (+5, Power Axe exchange). All non-Unique Iron Warriors Characters with Character special rule may buy at most ONE relic from an optional (0/1) ⚙️ Iron Warriors Relics radio immediately ahead of their renamed ⚙️ Iron Warriors Wargear. This is currently implemented on Chaos Lord, Warsmith, Daemonsmith only (existing qualifying Characters); all future eligible Characters MUST also get this Relics radio AND all associated per-named-relic global-uniqueness checks must be updated across all eligible unit entries. Purchased Relics charge points in the radio. Weapon Relics also get ⚙️ named weapon replacement choices immediately after each exact original Boltgun or Power Axe selection; weapon-choice cost is exactly original weapon cost, so buying the Relic and equipping the weapon charges only one +5 Relic surcharge. Weapon alternatives only show with relevant Relic purchased (or if the weapon is selected, for corrective visibility). Owner-unit selected-gated errors catch: chosen relic wrong Allegiance; purchased weapon Relic without matching equipped weapon; relic weapon selected without purchase; same purchased relic weapon equipped twice; any named relic purchased by more than one Character unit in army. No false error for unselected radio items. Unique characters excluded. Do not embed battle-rules text in New Recruit. If core Relics are later implemented enforce no other Relic on unit across both lists. Keep standalone option IDs stable. Game System revision 9 unchanged.

Each active Allegiance group must be mandatory 1/1 while its inactive counterpart has dynamic minimum 0, and hide the entire inactive subgroup only if no selected trait would be orphaned. An active Warlord must make an explicit trait selection; do not force a default core trait when roster is Iron Warriors. Preserve old core trait IDs and selected-safe, selected-gated unit-root 3-sentence Allegiance errors. New Warlord types must adopt the same structure; future Allegiances get their own radios, not mixed individual traits. Never include rules prose for Warlord traits in this catalogue. Presentation policy: put ⚙️ Allegiance-specific sections at the TOP of the unit options (Characters: Iron Warriors Relics then Iron Warriors Wargear before Warlord and body; Legionaries: top-level ⚙️ Iron Warriors group sortIndex=0 with other groups explicitly sorted afterward); when implementing any future unit, retain this ordering. Icon of Chaos on Legionaries and both Chosen types is a direct (0/1) checkbox entry in Additional Options (unchanged ID and price), NOT a single-item radio. Future standalone optional upgrades likewise use checkboxes. All changes are scoped to visual control layout and trait options; avoid modifying unrelated unit/equipment mechanics.

=== LONG WAR CHARACTER ATTACHMENTS (V1.4.45, 2026-11-01) ===
Source architecture: current local Reforged Chaos Space Marines catalogue, e.g. Chaos Lord associations and Legionaries May Attach To links plus host-side 2+ incoming association error. Do not redesign as free-text or numeric choice. This version creates exactly ONE roster-scoped association per existing Infantry Character (Chaos Lord, Warsmith, Daemonsmith), targeting a single hidden semantic category on eligible 2+-model Infantry units (Legionaries, both Chosen variants, Tyrant Siege Terminators). Association resolves to an actual unit instance, including multiple identically named units. A host root error detects 2+ incoming associations. No implicit mandatory attachment requirement: a Character may remain unattached. Prohibited attachment host types under the rules: Vehicle, Knight, Titan, Aircraft, Fortification. Walker and Automata are not current eligible hosts because all current Characters are Infantry and must attach to the SAME Unit Type, not because those types are categorically forbidden by this attachment rule. Future unit creation: Character -> same-type target association; eligible host -> category link + one-Character check; enforce two-model minimum and dynamic Unit Type where configurable. They were removed in V1.4.46 in favor of two-way, pure semantic Keyword checks with Undivided asymmetry. Retain only the association architecture and one-Chaos-Lord-family roster cap from this historical version. See the V1.4.46 handoff below for current rules and cautions. ===
